```
module security.passwords
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: The strength rating of a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong, Fair or Weak by its length and the kinds of characters it uses.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify("abc") is Weak
  example: classify("abcdefg") is Weak
  example: classify("abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify("Abcdefghijkl1") is Fair
  example: classify("Abcdefgh123!") is Strong

  let size be password.length()
  let has_letter be password.matches(raw ".*[A-Za-z].*")
  let has_digit be password.matches(raw ".*[0-9].*")
  let has_other be password.matches(raw ".*[^A-Za-z0-9].*")
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

test "a long mixed password is strong"
  check classify("Abcdefgh123!") is Strong
end

test "a long password without symbols is only fair"
  check classify("Abcdefghijkl1") is Fair
end

test "a short password is weak"
  check classify("abc") is Weak
end
```

```
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end
```

```
module security.passwords
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: The strength rating of a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
  can Equal
  can ToText
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong, Fair or Weak by its length and the kinds of characters it uses.
  tags: security, passwords
  see also: has_letter, has_digit, has_other
  example: classify("Abcdef123!xyz") is Strong
  example: classify("abcdefghijkl") is Fair
  example: classify("abcd1234") is Fair
  example: classify("short") is Weak

  let size be password.length()
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter(password) and has_digit(password) and has_other(password) then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

function has_letter(text: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether the text contains at least one letter.
  example: has_letter("12a") is true
  example: has_letter("123") is false

  return for each character in text.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[A-Za-z]$")
end

function has_digit(text: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether the text contains at least one digit.
  example: has_digit("abc1") is true
  example: has_digit("abc") is false

  return for each character in text.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[0-9]$")
end

function has_other(text: Text)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Tell whether the text contains a character that is neither a letter nor a digit.
  example: has_other("ab1!") is true
  example: has_other("ab1") is false

  return for each character in text.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[^A-Za-z0-9]$")
end

test "a long mixed password is strong"
  check classify("Abcdef123!xyz") is Strong
end

test "a long password without digits is only fair"
  check classify("abcdefghijkl") is Fair
end

test "a short password is weak"
  check classify("short") is Weak
end
```
